units.source_text: 老师似乎打算用这个办法了结这桩事件。

en.t: The teacher seemed to intend to settle the whole affair by this means.

units.source_text: 倒不是他对此事明确表示不闻不问，而似乎是要让我意识到我的行为是无效的。

en.t: It was not that he clearly declared he would have nothing to do with the matter, but rather that he seemed to want me to realize that my actions were futile.

units.source_text: 这种归还照片的奇妙方法，却突然让我浮想联翩。

en.t: Yet this strange way of returning the photograph suddenly set my imagination racing.
